sources.label: PD 1096: National Building Code of the Philippines — Framework for Utility Standards
sources.description: The NBCP provides the overarching framework for all building utility standards in the Philippines including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, and fire protection.

sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1
sources.description: Covers all electrical installations in buildings. Governing standard for wiring, equipment installation, overcurrent protection, and grounding.

sources.label: RA 9514: Fire Code of the Philippines
sources.description: Governing law for fire protection systems, fire alarm requirements, suppression systems, and fire safety inspections.

sources.label: Philippine Plumbing Code (PPC) — Latest Edition
sources.description: Governing standard for plumbing system design, installation, and inspection in Philippine buildings.

sources.label: NSCP 2015: National Structural Code of the Philippines
sources.description: Provides structural requirements that interact with utility system design including seismic bracing and equipment anchorage.
